name: Production Distro RC12
source: RC11 final audit; maestro-managed RC12 planning
goal: Plan and execute AIOS-body controlled unblock for real object publication binding, drift-zero reconciliation, quarantine fetch verification, exact approval with audit binding, AgentCore/SecurityExecution allow, controlled activation, rollback, and support/recovery evidence.
core_thesis: AIOS becomes distributable only when every release byte is immutable and locally verified, every declared/current identity matches, every fetched byte is quarantined before interpretation, and every activation or rollback effect is authorized through exact approval, AgentCore executable PlanSpec, SecurityExecutionEngine allow, audit, rollback, and support/recovery evidence.
non_goals: Do not build mirror frontend, nginx, TLS, remote signer, object storage, or remote dispatch infrastructure in RC12 body tasks.
Do not read, copy, print, hash, move, or reference private signing material.
Do not claim GA production readiness.
Do not treat mirror reachability, signer reachability, frontend output, shell output, TUI output, model replay, or object storage UI as authority.

Do not install, activate, rollback, mutate boot metadata, mutate active slots, mutate active artifact sets, mutate production rings, upload support bundles, or dispatch remote fleet actions unless a later task proves every gate and records the effect explicitly.
primary_acceptance: RC12 plan is active and task-managed with RC12-001 as the next executable task.

The plan covers real object publication binding, drift-zero reconciliation, object trust verification, quarantine fetch verification, AgentCore/SecurityExecution executable package, canary target and exact approval binding, controlled activation, rollback, support/recovery, and final audit.
The plan preserves AIOS-body-only scope and keeps mirror frontend, nginx, signer infrastructure, object storage provisioning, remote dispatch, and production ring mutation out of scope.
The plan keeps production_ready_claim=false until final audit proves every required gate.
